description: Read a stored object by storage_id. JSON comes back as data, an image as an image, and any other file, such as a PDF from html_to_pdf or a ZIP from process_image, as an embedded resource of at most 4 MB. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

storage_id.description: A storage_id from store_file, from a previous tool result, or from REST /storage. Objects expire 24 hours after they were stored.

name: read_stored_file
title: Read a stored file
